purpose: Magnesium is a natural mineral that your body needs to stay healthy. It is used to treat or prevent low magnesium levels, help with constipation, support heart health, ease muscle cramps, and even help some people sleep better or manage migraines. Doctors may also use it to help control certain heart rhythm problems or high blood pressure during pregnancy.
how_it_works: Think of magnesium as a helper mineral that keeps hundreds of processes in your body running smoothly. It helps your muscles relax, supports your nerves in sending the right signals, keeps your heart beating steadily, and helps your bones stay strong. When you do not have enough magnesium, muscles can cramp, your heart rhythm can get irregular, and you may feel tired or anxious — so replacing it helps everything work the way it should.
common_side_effects: The most common side effects are stomach upset, nausea, diarrhea, and loose stools — especially with higher doses. Taking it with food can help reduce stomach discomfort. Different forms of magnesium (like magnesium glycinate) tend to be gentler on the stomach than others (like magnesium oxide).
warnings: If you have kidney disease, be very careful — your kidneys may not be able to clear excess magnesium, and too much can build up to dangerous levels. Signs of too much magnesium include low blood pressure, muscle weakness, trouble breathing, or feeling very drowsy. Always tell your doctor or pharmacist about all the medicines you take, since magnesium can affect how some antibiotics and other medications are absorbed. Do not take high doses without checking with your healthcare provider first.
typical_dosing: For most adults, a typical dose is 200 to 400 mg per day, often taken once at bedtime or split into two doses. The right dose depends on why you are taking it and what form you are using. For constipation, a higher single dose may be used short-term. It is best to start low and increase slowly to avoid stomach upset. Always follow your doctor or pharmacist's specific instructions for your situation.
